title: Tree circuit compilation specification
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $c$ be a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables, let $g$ be a finite list of gates, and let $(g',v)$ consist of a finite list of gates and a natural-number vertex. The specification requires that $g'$ be obtained by appending a list of gates to $g$, that $g'$ be acyclic, and that $v<n+|g'|$; for every input $x$, the value at vertex $v$ in $g'$ must equal the evaluation of $c$ at $x$. It further requires $|g'|\le |g|+\mathrm{size}(c)$, that the depth at $v$ be at most $\mathrm{depth}(c)+1$, and that every gate in the appended portion be well formed and have at most $\max(1,\mathrm{maxFanin}(c))$ arguments.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit tree $c$ on $n$ variables
A result pair consisting of a finite gate list $g'$ and a natural-number vertex $v$
